Every endpoint of version 1, from the specification's [Appendix B](/specification/#appendix-b-endpoints), with the summary its OpenAPI operation gives. The path opens the operation in the [OpenAPI reference](/reference/openapi/); the section is where the specification defines it. *Auth* `none` means the endpoint takes no token; every other endpoint needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>` ([§4.2](/specification/#42-using-the-token)). A capability means the endpoint is optional: a client uses it only when discovery (`GET /chargewire`) lists that capability.
